parts.note: One authoring invariant. Activation covers relationship edits, existing unresolved references, and corpus deletions or identity changes; absent relationships remain excluded.

One resolution contract: set-first resolution with reporting instead of fabrication or silent omission. Its steps and tests are inseparable aspects of that contract; activation covers resolver design, implementation, and acceptance changes.
One implementation-cardinality constraint. Trigger covers new or changed resolution paths. Multiple modules are not incorrectly forbidden.
One placement constraint, activated by resolver placement and relocation work.
One graph-source-of-truth constraint, activated by graph construction or storage decisions.
One substrate prohibition. Activation targets docs-graph reuse, not unrelated traceability-graph maintenance.

graph.note: All three original edges are accounted for in edgeRemap: uniqueness and identity prerequisites attach to authoring and resolution, and the ADR registry requires resolve-or-report. Architecture parts are mutually reachable through resolve-or-report, so authoring and registry consumption both deliver the resolver architecture constraints and their prerequisites. Authoring requires resolution; resolver-only work need not activate author editing. No relevant obligation is orphaned. The new internal links express joint delivery, not new external prerequisites. Original edge metadata is not contradicted by the remapping.

audit.summary: The six parts preserve the source obligations, evidence, exceptions, policy, and graph relationships. Architecture constraints are independently scoped without weakening joint delivery. No new waiver or application-specific restriction was introduced; concrete paths and examples already occur in the source.

parts.risk: No material ambiguity: the four relationship verbs, declared-target requirement, remediation, absent-attribute exception, and refines exclusion are explicit.
No material ambiguity: set-first resolution, conditional edge admission, universal reporting, and the prohibitions on fabrication and silent dropping form one clear resolution contract.
No material ambiguity: exactly one implementation and no local re-resolution are stated directly.
The placement duty is clear, but 'this docs extension' depends on project context rather than naming a concrete extension path.
No material ambiguity: derivation from .adoc attributes, on-demand rebuilding, and the persistence prohibition are mutually reinforcing and explicit.
No material ambiguity: the prohibited substrate is identified by its concrete source path and the reason for the prohibition is clear.

review.summary: Independent coverage checking found every source obligation, exception, anti-pattern, numerical detail, and policy item represented. No segment is dropped; S032's omission of the incidental 'four lines' wording does not lose its mechanism or obligation, and shared:policy.strict-disposition preserves severity, strict failure, no advisory mode, and no ratchet baseline. The parts add no source-unsupported duty. Each has a distinct activation and obligation, while the requires edges jointly deliver authoring, resolution, and all four architecture constraints where needed. All three original edges are sensibly remapped, and the source alias resolves to all six parts.
